full_judgment:
Mr. Shahidul Islam, J.: By this Rule the Opposite party was called upon to show cause as to why the impugned judgment and order dated 27.04.2000 passed by the learned Joint District Judge, 3rd Court, Rangpur in Miscellaneous Case No. 18 of 1999 dismissing the appeal and affirming the judgment and order dated 18.2.1999 passed by the learned Senior Assistant Judge, Sadar, Rangpur in Miscellaneous Case No.50 of 1998 should not be set aside and or such other or further order or orders passed as to this Court may seem fit and proper. 

 3. The application under section 19(1) of the Premises Rent Control Act was registered as Judicial Miscellaneous No.50 of 1998. 

 4. The Petitioner examined himself as PW I and also adduced another witnesses in support of his case. The opposite party No.1 examined himself as PW 1. 

 5. The Rent Controller by the judgment and order dated 18.2.1999 rejected the said application holding that there was no landlord and tenant relationship between the parties and the Petitioner was a licensee. Against that order the Petitioner preferred Miscellaneous Appeal No. 18 of 1999. That appeal was heard by the learned Joint District Judge, 3rd Court, Rangpur who by the impugned judgment and order dated 27.4.2002 dismissed the appeal holding that there existent no relationship of landlord and tenant between the parties. 

 12. On perusal of the said provision of law it appears that it was required by the petitioner to make deposit of the rent with the Rent Controller which was returned back to him undelivered through post within fortnight of said received unnerved. In the instant case the petitioner without depositing any rent with the ' Rent Controller made an application which is not tenable in law. 

 14. In the result, the Rule is discharged with costs. The impugned judgment and order dated 27.4.2002 passed by the learned Joint District Judge, 3rd Court, Rangpur in Miscellaneous Case No 18 of 1999 dismissing the" appeal and affirming the judgment and order dated 18.2.1999 passed by the learned'. Senior Assistant Judge, Sadar, Rangpur in Miscellaneous Case No. 50.of 1.998 is hereby affirmed.
